item.title: Brief Bio and Dance History
item.description: Short Bio Nicholas has been teaching dance professionally since 2009. He started as a ballroom instructor, transitioned to Argentine Tango (won the US Championships in 2014), then stumbled into swing in 2018 starting with Collegiate Shag and Lindy Hop.

item.title: Balboa Syllabus

item.title: 1992 Balboa Contest the rebels
item.description: source: www.youtube.com/watch The Rebels Ed & Inez Thompson are incredible original Pure Balboa dancers. Natalie Esparza (in the dark dress dancing with the man (Phil) in the pink shirt) was an original SoCal Swing dancer.

item.title: Balboa Partnership Progression
item.description: Use this to sync with a partner and build a new partnership. Generally takes 2 to 8 practices to get through everything. Start with dancing, alternate 15 - 30 minute intervals of the progression and 5 to 10 minutes of dancing.
